in_sanskrit.name: Bhavika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Creator, Builder, or Illusion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhavika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhavika is derived from the Sanskrit root "Bhava", which means to be, to exist, to become, or to create. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess the power of creation or are considered to be builders of their own lives. In Hindu mythology, Bhavika is also associated with the illusion or Maya, symbolizing the idea that reality is not what it seems.
